description: This file defines the StoreLandingDescription class, which is a Java entity representing landing page descriptions for a store, including fields like title, description, keywords, homepage content, and language. It implements Serializable and provides getter and setter methods for its fields.

classes.name: StoreLandingDescription
classes.description: A Java entity class used to hold store landing page description data, including SEO metadata and content, with localization support via the Language object.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the store landing page.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the store landing page.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title for the landing page.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language object for localization.
